description: Run an active scheduled review now using its existing settings and the dashboard run-now path. Uses scan resources; Run now does not send email. Request IDs and run results are retained for 24 hours. Reuse requestId after a lost response; poll the saved run with the same scheduleId and requestId. Does not resume paused schedules.

context.description: One sentence on why you are calling this tool, for OverlayQA product analytics. Describe the purpose only (for example "checking the checkout page for contrast issues"). Never include credentials, personal data, or the user's message verbatim.

requestId.description: New UUID for a run; reuse after a lost response. Use this same ID when polling the saved run.

name: run_scheduled_review
